data.name: Agni
data.gender_notes: Agni is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit agni, 'fire', from the root ag, 'to move, drive'. Its root is Sanskrit agni (अग्नि). Agni, the Vedic god of fire. Agni is a Sanskrit name meaning “Fire; the fire god”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Agni expresses “Fire; the fire god”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit agni, 'fire', from the root ag, 'to move, drive'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Agni total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
